description: Pure-data finite endofunction spec. The finite set is the mixed-radix product Z/2 x Z/4 x Z/4 x Z/2. Each leg computes the transition tables, SCC quotient, terminal SCCs, and Z/2-involution checks independently from this data.

update_law_identifiers.conserved_control: preserve the z2 coordinate after the base update
update_law_identifiers.parity_flipping_law: on the selected readout boundary event, flip z2 coordinate from 0 to 1 only; this asymmetric law is used for the structural non-equivariance check
update_law_identifiers.reference_toggle_law: on the selected readout boundary event, complement the z2 coordinate; this preserves the faithful parity-toggle behavior for comparison

selected_boundary_event: after a base update crosses a radix_digit_1 or radix_digit_0 boundary, the current radix_digit_0 row is the orientation row and orientation_sign times next readout sign is negative

involution_definition.operation: complement the coordinate at index 3 and fix coordinates 0, 1, and 2

lineage.F01: simultaneous-distinguishability surface: the SCC quotient is computed on the whole finite endofunction table, so identity is the computed communicating class rather than a primitive label.
lineage.N01: order/persistence: each transition map composes the fixed word readout, mixed-radix carry, and z2-coordinate update in one measured order.
lineage.root_axiom: a = a iff a ~ b; here ~ is the mutually reachable SCC equivalence relation induced by the computed endofunction.

legacy_project_labels.basin: terminal SCC / basin of attraction in the old owner vocabulary
legacy_project_labels.engine: orientation map in the pure-math naming
legacy_project_labels.sector: fiber over a fixed z2 coordinate
